lesson: Stand up straight with your shoulders back and face the world as someone who can bear responsibility.
Treat yourself like someone you are responsible for helping.
Make friends with people who want the best for you.
Compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not to who someone else is today.
Set your own house in perfect order before you criticize the world.
Pursue what is meaningful, not what is expedient.
Tell the truth, or at least don't lie.
Assume the person you are listening to might know something you don't.
Be precise in your speech so problems can be named and then solved.
Do not do what you hate, because resentment poisons the soul.
Make at least one thing better every single place you go.
Plan and work diligently to maintain the romance in your relationship.
You have power over your mind, not outside events; realize this and you will find strength.
The obstacle in your path can become the path itself.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good person should be; be one.
Expect to meet difficult people each day, and do not let their behavior make you behave badly.
Do each task as if it were the last of your life, with full attention and without drama.
The best revenge is not to become like the one who wronged you.
Some things are within our control and some are not; focus only on the first.
People are disturbed not by things, but by their judgments about things.
If you want to improve, be content to look foolish for a while.
First decide who you want to be, then do what you have to do.
Don't explain your philosophy; live it.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Life is long enough if you know how to use it.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
Spend time with people who are likely to make you better.
While we put off living, life rushes past.
We become brave by doing brave acts and just by doing just acts.
Virtue lies in the middle ground between excess and deficiency.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
To see what is right and not do it is a lack of courage.
Do not impose on others what you would not want for yourself.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
True wisdom begins with admitting how little you know.
Your life is shaped by your mind, so train your thoughts with care.
Suffering grows from craving, so loosen your grip on what you cannot keep.
Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not.
Of all the things wisdom provides for a happy life, friendship is the greatest.
The mind is not a vessel to be filled but a fire to be kindled.
Know yourself and know your opponent, and you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.
The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
If you cannot be both, it is safer to be feared than loved.
Reflecting on death teaches you how to live without fear.
The greatest thing in the world is to know how to belong to yourself.
When you can no longer change a situation, you are challenged to change yourself.
Everything can be taken from you except the freedom to choose your attitude.
Become genuinely interested in other people, and they will become interested in you.
Remember that a person's name is to them the sweetest sound in any language.
Seek first to understand, then to be understood.
Begin with the end in mind.
You do not rise to the level of your goals; you fall to the level of your systems.
Every action is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
Deep, focused work is rare and valuable, so protect your attention.
Be so good they can't ignore you.
Seek wealth, not money or status, by owning assets that earn while you sleep.
Play long-term games with long-term people.
Invert, always invert: think about what would cause failure and avoid it.
Go to bed a little wiser each day than when you woke up.
Well done is better than well said.
Lost time is never found again.
Some things benefit from shocks; aim to grow stronger from disorder, not merely survive it.
Don't take advice from people who have no skin in the game.
Ego is the enemy of what you want and of what you have.
Stillness is the key to clear thinking and good decisions.
Vulnerability is not weakness; it is the birthplace of courage and connection.
Clear is kind; unclear is unkind.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
Knowing your own darkness is the best way to deal with the darkness of others.
You may not control all events, but you can refuse to be reduced by them.
When someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time.
The present moment is the only place life ever happens.
Nothing in life is as important as you think it is while you are thinking about it.
Slow down for important decisions; fast intuition is often confidently wrong.
It takes twenty years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
The best investment you can make is in yourself.
Define your fears instead of your goals, and they usually shrink.
Being busy is not the same as being productive.
When you think you are done, you are only at about forty percent of what you can do.
Callus your mind by choosing hard things on purpose.
Discipline equals freedom.
Take extreme ownership: no excuses, no blaming others.
Be like water: adapt to whatever shape the situation requires.
Fear the one who has practiced one kick ten thousand times, not ten thousand kicks once.
Credit belongs to the person actually in the arena, not the critic on the sidelines.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
Choose carefully what you give a damn about, because you can't care about everything.
Who you are is defined by what you are willing to struggle for.
Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
Service to others is the rent you pay for your room here on earth.
Courage is not the absence of fear but the triumph over it.
Leave bitterness behind when you walk free, or you remain in prison.
Never give in, except to convictions of honour and good sense.
Courage is the first of human qualities, because it guarantees all the others.
Have a clear vision of what you want, then work like hell to get there.
Don't just be useful to yourself; be useful to others.
Very little is needed for a happy life; it is all within you, in your way of thinking.
Remember that you could leave life right now, and let that decide what you do and say.
No one is free who is not master of themselves.
You are an actor in a play chosen by another; your job is to play your part well.
Count each day as a separate life.
Rehearse hardship in calm times so it cannot catch you unprepared.
Philosophy is worthless unless it is practiced in how you live.
We have two ears and one mouth so that we listen more than we speak.
If you wish to be loved, love.
A true friend is one soul living in two bodies.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
Act with malice toward none and charity for all.
Talk in terms of the other person's interests.
Think win-win: look for solutions where both sides come out ahead.
Lasting love is built by turning toward your partner in small everyday moments.
Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
Good relationships keep us happier and healthier than wealth or fame.
The most precious gift you can offer someone is your full presence.
Whoever has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Live deliberately, so you do not discover at the end that you never really lived.
Advance confidently toward your dreams and you will meet with unexpected success.
If you don't know which port you are sailing to, no wind is favorable.
Meaning can be found in work, in love, and in the courage with which you face suffering.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
Aim at the highest good you can conceive of, and let that guide your steps.
Try to make one room in your home as beautiful as possible.
What counts in life is the difference you have made to the lives of others.
Life's most persistent and urgent question is: what are you doing for others?
Be grateful in spite of your suffering.
Nothing in life is to be feared; it is only to be understood.
In the depths of winter you can find within you an invincible summer.
Abilities grow through effort, good strategies, and help from others.
You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
Life is either a daring adventure or nothing.
Keep a beginner's mind, because it holds many possibilities and the expert's mind holds few.
When something goes wrong, say "good" and look for the advantage in it.
Do not hide unwanted things in the fog; name problems and face them.
Missing once is an accident; never miss twice.
Clarity about what matters gives you clarity about what does not.
Face the accountability mirror and be brutally honest about where you fall short.
Improvement comes from deliberate practice just beyond your current ability.
How we spend our days is how we spend our lives.
Work on one virtue at a time and review your progress each evening.
Life can only be understood backwards, but it must be lived forwards.
You must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
Show me the incentive and I will show you the outcome.
No one steps in the same river twice, for it is not the same river and they are not the same person.
Keep asking "what do I really know?" and hold your opinions loosely.
Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
Nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
The happiness of your life depends on the quality of your thoughts.
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
Look within: there is a spring of goodness that will keep flowing if you keep digging.
When you rise in the morning, remember what a privilege it is to be alive, to think, to enjoy, to love.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
Circumstances don't make the person; they only reveal them to themselves.
Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
It is not what happens to you, but how you respond to it, that matters.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
It is not the one who has too little who is poor, but the one who craves more.
Begin at once to live.
No one is more unfortunate than the person who never meets adversity, for they never get to test themselves.
Stop hoping and you will stop fearing, for both belong to a mind fixed on the future.
If you do something good with effort, the effort passes quickly but the good remains.
Well-being is reached little by little, and yet it is no little thing.
Fate leads the willing and drags the unwilling.
Whoever is brave is free.
We are what we repeatedly do; excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
Success is a few simple disciplines, practiced every day.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Eat the frog: do your hardest, most important task first thing each day.
Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
Make good habits obvious, attractive, easy and satisfying.
Don't count on motivation; count on discipline.
Rest at the end, not in the middle.
Long-term consistency beats short-term intensity.
Enthusiasm is common; endurance is rare.
You will never have a greater or lesser dominion than that over yourself.
The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.
If you don't prioritize your life, someone else will.
If you want to change the world, start off by making your bed.
Put first things first: organize and execute around your priorities.
Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
Becoming is better than being.
Between stimulus and response there is a space, and in that space lies your freedom to choose.
The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
When you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
The mind is its own place, and can make a heaven of hell, a hell of heaven.
I have not failed; I've just found ten thousand ways that won't work.
I've failed over and over again in my life, and that is why I succeed.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world; today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
We don't see things as they are; we see them as we are.
Opportunity lurks where responsibility has been abandoned.
Focus on the effort, not the outcome; the effort is what you control.
Mentally strong people don't waste energy feeling sorry for themselves.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
Where focus goes, energy flows.
No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
Any fool can criticize, condemn and complain, and most fools do.
Give honest and sincere appreciation.
People will forget what you said, but they will never forget how you made them feel.
Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
Being deeply loved gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
The quality of your relationships determines the quality of your life.
Repair quickly after conflict; a small gesture of goodwill can turn an argument around.
Connection is why we're here; it gives purpose and meaning to our lives.
Most people listen with the intent to reply; listen with the intent to understand.
Darkness cannot drive out darkness, only light can; hate cannot drive out hate, only love can.
The weak can never forgive; forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
We were born to work together, like feet, like hands, like eyelids.
Wishing to be friends is quick work, but friendship is a slow-ripening fruit.
Deep listening can relieve the suffering of another person.
Friendship is born when one person says to another, "What! You too? I thought I was the only one."
The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
Where your talents and the needs of the world cross, there lies your vocation.
The purpose of human life is to serve, and to show compassion and the will to help others.
The purpose of life is not just to be happy, but to be useful, honorable and compassionate.
Don't ask what the world needs; ask what makes you come alive, and go do that.
Follow your bliss, and doors will open where there were only walls.
Start with why: people don't buy what you do, they buy why you do it.
Become who you are.
Meaning is found in shouldering the heaviest responsibility you can bear.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing themselves.
The meaning of life is to find your gift; the purpose of life is to give it away.
The most common regret of the dying is not having lived a life true to themselves.
Find a truth that is true for you, an idea for which you can live and die.
I slept and dreamt that life was joy; I woke and saw that life was service; I acted, and behold, service was joy.
The richest person is the one who is content with the least.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler.
I would rather have questions that can't be answered than answers that can't be questioned.
Knowing what you don't know is more useful than being brilliant.
Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.
Read what you love until you love to read.
Much of humanity's trouble comes from our inability to sit quietly in a room alone.
The best is the enemy of the good.
Fools and fanatics are always so certain, and wiser people so full of doubts.
If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.
Raise your words, not your voice; it is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
Doing well with money has little to do with how smart you are and a lot to do with how you behave.
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
Absorb what is useful, discard what is not, and add what is uniquely your own.
Empty your mind, be formless and shapeless, like water.
Do not pray for an easy life; pray for the strength to endure a difficult one.
Knowing is not enough, you must apply; willing is not enough, you must do.
Simplicity is the key to brilliance: hack away the unessential.
Mistakes are always forgivable if you have the courage to admit them.
If you always put limits on everything you do, they will spread into your work and your life.
You are not in this world to live up to other people's expectations, nor they to yours.
Use no way as way, and have no limitation as limitation.
A goal is not always meant to be reached; often it simply serves as something to aim at.
Defeat is a state of mind; no one is truly defeated until they accept it as reality.
The less effort, the faster and more powerful you will be.
Do not think. Feel. Thinking too much in the moment makes you hesitate.
Learning is never cumulative; it is a movement of knowing that has no beginning and no end.
To hell with circumstances; I create opportunities.
As you think, so shall you become.
Showing off is the fool's idea of glory.
Be pliable like a reed in a storm: what bends survives, what is rigid snaps.
Real living is living for others.
It is not a daily increase but a daily decrease: hack away at what is unessential.
Under the right conditions, a small mind can become a great one. Choose your conditions.
The key to immortality is first living a life worth remembering.
A quick temper will make a fool of you soon enough.
Self-knowledge is the basis of all knowledge; honestly expressing yourself is the hardest thing.
Like everyone else, you want to learn the way to win, but never to accept the way to lose. Accepting defeat teaches you how to win.
Holding on to anger is like grasping a hot coal to throw at someone; you are the one who gets burned.
No one saves us but ourselves. We ourselves must walk the path.
Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
Hatred never ends through hatred; it ends only through love. This is an eternal law.
A jug fills drop by drop, and so does a wise person fill with good, gathered little by little.
Do not dwell in the past or dream of the future; concentrate the mind on the present moment.
Conquering yourself is a greater victory than conquering a thousand battles.
Three things cannot long stay hidden: the sun, the moon and the truth.
Do not believe something just because you heard it or because a teacher said it; test it, and accept it when you see it is good.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it outside.
Pain is the first arrow; your resistance to it is the second. You only have to be struck once.
My teaching is a raft for crossing the river. Once you have crossed, don't carry the raft on your head.
Just as a rock is not shaken by the wind, the wise are not moved by praise or blame.
Guard your words: before you speak, ask if it is true, if it is helpful and if this is the right time.
A tamed mind brings happiness; an untamed mind is the source of suffering.
Thousands of candles can be lit from one candle without shortening its life. Happiness is not reduced by sharing it.
Be a lamp unto yourself; do not look for refuge outside yourself.
Like a strong horse with a touch of the whip, be ardent and keep going.
There is no fire like passion, no grip like hatred, no net like delusion and no river like craving.
Seeing a grief-stricken mother search for a home untouched by death taught that loss is shared by all, and that sharing it softens it.
Everything that arises will pass away. Enjoy things fully, and hold them lightly.
Your bad mood, like your good one, is a passing weather system, not the sky itself.

figure: Buddhist teaching: The Four Noble Truths
lesson: Life contains suffering, suffering has a cause, it can end, and there is a path that ends it. Begin by seeing it clearly.
Neither indulgence nor harsh self-denial leads to freedom. Find the middle path between extremes.
Tune your effort like a lute string: too tight and it snaps, too loose and it will not play.
Speak only what is true, kind and useful, and at the right time.
Earn your living in a way that does no harm to others.
Prevent unwholesome states from arising, and nurture the wholesome ones that already exist.
Know what you are doing while you are doing it.
You are not your thoughts; you are the awareness in which they appear and disappear.
Hold your identity loosely. The fixed self you defend so hard is more process than thing.
Much of suffering is the gap between how things are and how you insist they should be.
Wanting more is a thirst that drinking cannot quench. Notice the thirst before you reach for the cup.
Every intention is a seed. What you repeatedly choose, you become.
Wish well to yourself, then to those you love, then to strangers, then even to those who wrong you.
Compassion is meeting another's pain without turning away.
Take joy in other people's good fortune. Envy shrinks you; shared joy multiplies.
Equanimity is not indifference; it is a calm heart that stays steady through gain and loss.
Nothing exists on its own. Everything arises from causes and conditions, so change the conditions.
Look deeply at a sheet of paper and you will see the cloud, the rain and the tree within it.
Each of us is a jewel reflecting all the others. What you do to one, you do to the whole.
Desire, ill will, sluggishness, restlessness and doubt cloud the mind. Name them, and they lose their grip.
The mind leaps from branch to branch like a monkey. Don't fight it; gently bring it back, again and again.
Giving is the first of the perfections; begin there, and the rest becomes easier.
Patience is the antidote to anger. The person who tests you is your teacher.
Water is the softest thing, yet it can wear away the hardest stone.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
Do the difficult while it is still easy, and the great while it is still small.
Be content with what you have and rejoice in the way things are. When you realise nothing is lacking, the whole world belongs to you.
Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know.
The best leader is barely known. When the work is done, the people say, 'We did it ourselves.'
Act without striving, work without forcing. This is wu wei.
Life is a series of natural changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow.
A tree as wide as a man's embrace grows from a tiny shoot.
If you are depressed you are living in the past; if you are anxious you are living in the future; if you are at peace you are living in the present.
The usefulness of a cup is in its emptiness. Make space in your life.
He who stands on tiptoe does not stand firm.
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
The stiff and unbending are disciples of death; the soft and yielding are disciples of life.
Flow with whatever may happen and let your mind be free.
The butcher whose knife stayed sharp for nineteen years never hacked; he found the natural gaps and let the blade move through them.
A useless tree that no carpenter wants lives to a great age. Not everything has to be useful to be valuable.
Was I a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or a butterfly dreaming I was a man? Hold your certainties loosely.
The fish trap exists for the fish; once you have the fish, forget the trap. Words exist for meaning.
Happiness is the absence of the striving for happiness.
The frog in the well cannot imagine the ocean. Step outside your well.
Who can say whether a misfortune is not a blessing? Wait and see before you judge what happens to you.
The farmer's horse ran away. 'Bad luck,' said the neighbours. 'Maybe,' said the farmer. Good and bad are rarely as clear as they seem.
Every strength carries a weakness and every darkness a seed of light. Seek balance, not one extreme.
When you see a worthy person, think of becoming their equal; when you see an unworthy one, examine yourself.
Real knowledge is knowing the extent of your own ignorance.
The person who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
Before you embark on a journey of revenge, dig two graves.
Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
Choose a job you love and you will never have to work a day in your life.
To be wronged is nothing unless you continue to remember it.
If you make a mistake and do not correct it, that is the real mistake.
The superior person is modest in speech but exceeds in action.
Learning without thought is labour lost; thought without learning is dangerous.
Every day, examine yourself: have I been loyal, trustworthy, and have I practised what I learned?
Everyone has a heart that cannot bear the suffering of others. Cultivate it like a sprout.
Don't pull on the seedlings to help them grow. Patient care, not force, brings growth.
Before heaven gives someone a great task, it first tests their resolve with hardship.
Not hearing is not as good as hearing, hearing is not as good as seeing, seeing is not as good as knowing, knowing is not as good as doing.
A horse that travels ten paces a day arrives in ten days. Success lies in not giving up.
Knowledge and action are one. To know and not to act is not yet to know.
It is easy to defeat the bandits in the mountains, but hard to defeat the bandits in your own heart.
In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
Victorious warriors win first and then go to war; defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
Appear weak when you are strong and strong when you are weak.
Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
Strategy without tactics is the slowest route to victory; tactics without strategy is the noise before defeat.
Let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt.
Do nothing that is of no use.
Think lightly of yourself and deeply of the world.
There is nothing outside yourself that can enable you to get better, stronger or wiser. Everything is within.
Today is victory over yourself of yesterday; tomorrow is your victory over lesser men.
Accept everything just the way it is.
Do not regret what you have done.
A thousand days of training to forge, ten thousand days to polish.
From one thing, know ten thousand things.
Perceive that which cannot be seen with the eye.
Do not seek pleasure for its own sake.
Matters of great concern should be treated lightly, and matters of small concern seriously.
There is nothing other than the purpose of the present moment. A life is a succession of moments.
Make your decisions within the space of seven breaths.
Whether people are of high or low rank, rich or poor, old or young, enlightened or confused, all are alike in that they will one day die.
Rectitude, courage, benevolence, respect, honesty, honour and loyalty: live by a code before you need one.
Each of you is perfect the way you are, and you can use a little improvement.
When you do something, burn yourself up completely, like a good bonfire, leaving no trace of yourself.
To give your sheep a large meadow is the way to control them. Give your thoughts room and they settle.
If you cannot find the truth right where you are, where else do you expect to find it?
To study the self is to forget the self.
Cooking the rice is practice. Treat ordinary work as the path, not a distraction from it.
All know the way; few actually walk it.
Let the mind be like empty space, and stop chasing after things.
If you meet the Buddha on the road, kill him. Don't make an idol of any teacher, idea or image.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
When walking, walk. When eating, eat.
The obstacle is the path.
Sit for twenty minutes a day, unless you are too busy; then sit for an hour.
Let go, or be dragged.
A cup already full can hold no more tea. Empty your cup before asking to be taught.
The finger pointing at the moon is not the moon. Don't confuse the teaching with the truth.
One monk carried a woman across a river and set her down; hours later the other still carried her in his mind.
Tigers above, tigers below, and a ripe strawberry within reach. How sweet it tasted. Savour the moment you have.
Is that so? Meet praise and blame alike with the same quiet acceptance.
The thief left it behind: the moon at my window. What truly matters cannot be stolen.
Every day, priests minutely examine the Dharma, but they fail to read the scripture of their own lives.
Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of the wise; seek what they sought.
Beauty lives in the imperfect, the incomplete and the impermanent.
Broken pottery is mended with gold. Your repairs are part of your story, not something to hide.
Look for the overlap of what you love, what you are good at, what the world needs and what sustains you.
Improve by one percent, every day, without end.
One time, one meeting. This exact moment with this person will never come again; treat it that way.
Cherry blossoms are loved because they fall. Let transience deepen your appreciation, not your fear.
Approach even familiar things with the openness and eagerness of a beginner.
No-mind: act without the clutter of fear, ego or overthinking, and skill flows freely.
Endure the seemingly unbearable with patience and dignity.
Fall down seven times, stand up eight.
True victory is victory over oneself.
Failure is the key to success; each mistake teaches us something.
Do not look upon this world with fear and loathing. Bravely face whatever the gods offer.
Maximum efficiency, mutual welfare and benefit. Use your energy wisely, and help others rise with you.
The ultimate aim of karate lies not in victory or defeat, but in the perfection of character.
Smile, breathe and go slowly.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
Walk as if you are kissing the earth with your feet.
Without mud, there is no lotus. Your suffering can become the soil of your growth.
Wash the dishes to wash the dishes, not to get them done.
When you love someone, the best thing you can offer is your presence.
Anger is like a crying baby. Hold it tenderly and it will calm.
People have a hard time letting go of their suffering; out of fear of the unknown, they prefer suffering that is familiar.
Understanding is love's other name. If you don't understand, you can't love.
The present moment is filled with joy and happiness. If you are attentive, you will see it.
If you want others to be happy, practise compassion. If you want to be happy, practise compassion.
If a problem can be fixed, there is no need to worry. If it can't be fixed, worrying will do no good.
Remember that not getting what you want is sometimes a wonderful stroke of luck.
Be kind whenever possible. It is always possible.
When you lose, don't lose the lesson.
Our prime purpose in this life is to help others, and if you can't help them, at least don't hurt them.
You cannot cover the whole earth with leather, but leather on your soles achieves the same. Change your mind, not the world.
If something can be remedied, why be unhappy about it? If it cannot be remedied, what use is being unhappy?
Things lack fixed, independent essence. Seeing this frees you from clinging.
You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
Nothing ever goes away until it has taught us what we need to know.
Lean into the sharp points. Fear is a natural reaction to moving closer to the truth.
This glass is already broken. Because I know that, every moment with it is precious.
If you let go a little, you will have a little peace. If you let go completely, you will have complete peace.
You have a right to your actions, but never to the fruits of your actions.
It is better to live your own path imperfectly than to live another's perfectly.
The mind is restless and hard to control, but it is tamed by practice and detachment.
For one who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; for one who has not, it is the greatest enemy.
